title: DS-2R…DS-6R - Deesys Protection Current Transformer, class 5P, 250–5000 A
description: Deesys protection current transformers for relay duty, primary ratings from 250 A up to 5000 A, secondary AC 5 A / 1 A, accuracy class 5P with over-current numeric n > 10 or n > 20. Window (busbar-through) construction. Series: DS-2R, DS-3R, DS-4R, DS-5R (DS-5-2R) and DS-6R.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Over-current intensity 40 In (thermal and mechanical, no change)

rows: DS-2R : 1st rating 250–400 A, n > 10, burden 5 VA
DS-3R : 1st rating 150–600 A, n > 10, burden 5–10 VA
DS-4R : 1st rating 600–1500 A, n > 10, burden 5–10 VA
DS-5R (DS-5-2R) : 1st rating 1000–4000 A, n > 10 / n > 20, burden 5–40 VA / 5–15 VA
DS-6R : 1st rating 1500–5000 A, n > 10 / n > 20, burden 5–40 VA / 5–15 VA
JEC1201 : 5 VA / 10 VA / 15 VA / 25 VA / 40 VA
